name: Documents only, applied by hand
description: Understanding alone: the same explanation, templates and steps, with records kept as documents, a sheet or a board by a person or an agent, and metrics read from whatever notes someone keeps. Nothing is installed.
advantages: Needs no code or install, works in any place records can be written, and is the quickest start (the one-hour guide).
disadvantages: Nothing checks the records, links drift unnoticed, and nothing selects the best implementation, so reviewers fall back to reading implementations.

name: Through the four containers
description: The root calls Understanding, Structure, Optimization and Runtime, each through its one-line entry, in the order the work happens: explanation and templates, steps and the author's skill, read by people and agents, with the esoi tools beside them. The records are checked on every change, alternatives are measured, and the implementation the metric ranks best is the one selected. The documents carry what a person must decide; the tools carry what can be checked.
advantages: Records are checked rather than trusted, so humans need only review metrics (and can still add value to implementations); the documents still work for anyone who never installs the tools. Selected because: a declared decision pending measurement: with the tools the records are checked and the best implementation is selected by metric (principle 4), where documents only leave both to the reader
disadvantages: The tools are Python and cost upkeep; a reader who skips the documents still builds records the tools cannot judge.

name: Calls each part in the order the work happens
description: The flow calls the one-line entry of each part of Understanding in turn and gathers what each reports; the parts are typed needs, so each one can be replaced without changing the flow.
advantages: One call shows what every part says about a project, and each part can be measured and replaced on its own.
disadvantages: A specification of the order only: it adds no behaviour of its own, so its value is the clarity of the hierarchy.
